resources.string: %1$s dashboard password reset. Use the initial-password button on the local account page.

Generate a new random initial password while keeping the username, two-factor authentication, models, plugins and chat data. If AstrBot is running, it restarts and previous dashboard sessions expire. Fill in the initial password here after the reset and change it after signing in.

Generate a new random dashboard token, keeping QQ login data, OneBot and other settings. Only SnowLuma restarts if running, briefly interrupting QQ. View the new token here; the old token stops working.
